name: black_mamba_reared
description: Black mamba (Dendroaspis polylepis) reared in the warning pose, facing right: about forty percent of the olive-grey (#7f8865) body rises nearly vertically out of loose flat ground coils (x -260..+60, y -60..0), darker back, pale cream belly with scute lines, long coffin-shaped head held level with a heavy brow and a small dark eye. Anchor bottom-centre where the coils touch the ground; bbox about x -262..+200, y -450..0; head at about (+140,-420), eye (+152,-430). Same geometry as black_mamba_reared / _hood / _hood_gape (only the neck and mouth change). Slim neck, no hood, mouth closed (straight line). Clean silhouette for silhouette: true. Eye is a white cartoon eye (silhouette_keep), so silhouettes still show it.
